assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The service is medically necessary given the recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
The service addresses the patient's documented supraventricular tachycardia and correlates symptoms with rhythm disturbances
Coverage is satisfied under CPT 93229 with diagnoses I47.1 and I25.10
